name: elemental-air-above-the-weather
brief: Above The Weather. Open sky at altitude: no ground, no horizon, only drift. Breath made audible by two flutes trading short phrases, wind chimes and glass mallets sparkling above them, Csus2 harmony that never resolves. No percussion kit and no bass weight: gravity is the wrong element. The outro disperses upward into the intro wind bed at the loop point rather than landing.

_duration_basis: 92 BPM, 4/4 -> one bar = 4*60/92 = 2.608696 s. 128 bars = 333.913 s -> plan duration 334 s (SunoGenerateRequest.duration is Optional[int]). Inside the planner rail (planner.py MIN_DURATION_S=30 at line 103, MAX_DURATION_S=600 at line 104 - the cap was 420 when this brief was written). The binding check is the family rubric: music/rubrics/gamer.json criterion loop_safety states 'duration_s * bpm / 240 should land near a whole bar count' -> 334*92/240 = 128.03 bars. 128 = 8 x 16-bar phrases, so every section boundary in the tag sheet (16/16/32/16/32/16) is a whole phrase. Tradeoff recorded as O3: 334 s is 1.80 plays of the 600 s loop-10min shape (600 s = exactly 230 bars at 92 BPM); the exact-divisor alternative is 115 bars = 300.000 s, rejected because 115 = 7x16+3 breaks the phrase grid.
